format: bash script / Makefile fragment / build configuration
description: This file appears to be a Yocto build recipe or include file for configuring, building, and installing the Rust compiler and runtime libraries within a Yocto/OpenEmbedded build environment. It contains variables, functions, and scripts specific to setting up Rust, building snapshots, configuring build environments, and installing targets.
external_files: configparser / ConfigParser (dependent on environment and Python version)

methods.name: setup_cargo_environment
methods.description: Configures the Cargo build environment for the target architecture, writing configuration details to the cargo config file.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Generates a 'config.toml' file configuring the build system for Rust, including targets, environment paths, compiler options, and installation directories.

methods.name: rust_runx
methods.description: Builds Rust projects, unsets environment variables CFLAGS, LDFLAGS, CXXFLAGS, CPPFLAGS to prevent interference, and calls the Rust bootstrap script.

methods.name: rust_do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled Rust stage2 binaries and libraries into the build's destination directory.

methods.name: rust_install_targets
methods.description: Installs custom target.json files for cross-compilation targets into the appropriate directory.
